scope: Sixteen finite trap-restoration contexts after failed execution of an owned nonexecutable file or absent pathname. Self-directed signals only; GNU output/status comparison and complete Valgrind tracing.

results.name: usr1
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo usr1' USR1
exec ./nonexec
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: usr2
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo usr2' USR2
exec ./nonexec
kill -USR2 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: alarm
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo alarm' ALRM
exec ./nonexec
kill -ALRM $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: repeat
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo restored' USR1
for n in 1 2 3; do exec ./nonexec; kill -USR1 $$; done
printf "after\n"

results.name: two-signals
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo one' USR1
trap 'echo two' USR2
exec ./nonexec
kill -USR1 $$
kill -USR2 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: ignored
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap '' TERM
trap 'echo one' USR1
exec ./nonexec
kill -TERM $$
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: replace
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo old' USR1
exec ./nonexec
trap 'echo new' USR1
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: reset
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo old' USR1
exec ./nonexec
trap - USR1
trap -p USR1
printf "after\n"

results.name: function
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo one' USR1
f() { exec ./nonexec; }
f
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: group
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo one' USR1
{ exec ./nonexec; }
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: exit-trap
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo end' EXIT
trap 'echo one' USR1
exec ./nonexec
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: in-handler
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'exec ./nonexec; echo handler' USR1
kill -USR1 $$
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: handler-replace
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
f() { exec ./nonexec; trap 'echo replacement' USR1; }
trap f USR1
kill -USR1 $$
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: enoent
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo one' USR1
exec ./not-present
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: clean-environment
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo one' USR1
exec -c ./nonexec
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"

results.name: command-builtin
results.script:
shopt -s execfail
trap 'echo one' USR1
command exec ./nonexec
kill -USR1 $$
printf "after\n"
